subject.title: Memory MVP: define SQLite schema and canonical record model

question: Should memory-core’s durable memory source of truth move from Markdown files to a plugin-owned typed SQLite record model for the MVP, and what migration/provenance/review contract must ship with it?
rationale: The request defines persistent user state and a product contract that affects storage ownership, upgrade behavior, provenance, write-pipeline behavior, review/edit/forget flows, and the sibling Memory MVP issues.

options.title: Approve SQLite MVP model
options.body: Define the v1 record/status/revision/provenance contract first, then implement schema and migrations in the memory plugin boundary.

options.title: Keep Markdown canonical
options.body: Narrow or close this schema effort and continue treating SQLite as retrieval/index infrastructure around Markdown durable memory.

options.title: Defer Memory Convergence
options.body: Keep the issue as design backlog until maintainers choose the recommended memory plugin path called out in VISION.md.

recommendation.title: Approve SQLite MVP model
recommendation.body: Define the v1 record/status/revision/provenance contract first, then implement schema and migrations in the memory plugin boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is product/storage direction, and Peter has the strongest maintainer-routing signal from broad recent history across the memory area.
